organization: Society for Research in Child Development (SRCD)
public_contact_or_submission: public site with Contact Us, press room and membership routes
why_relevant: main professional body for developmental science; a ground-visible community entry point for a shape claim about caregiving and child outcomes
notes: use the public contact form, not named staff addresses; site lists a 2027 Biennial Meeting and three journals

public_contact_or_submission: public journals page with per-journal Submit links
why_relevant: lists Child Development, Child Development Perspectives and Monographs with explicit Submit links; an opt-in route to expert readers
notes: the Oxford Academic author-guidelines URL returned 403 on direct fetch; the SRCD portal Submit links were verified instead

public_contact_or_submission: submission via the Submit link on the SRCD journals page
why_relevant: flagship peer-reviewed outlet for empirical and theoretical child-development work; direct venue for a per-slot caregiving claim
notes: anonymous peer review; check current scope and word limits on the journal page before submitting

field: developmental psychopathology, caregiving and early adversity
public_contact_or_submission: Submit manuscript button on the journal home page
why_relevant: multidisciplinary journal on typical and atypical development; the Baron-Cohen 2025 mind-mindedness paper and several caregiving-adversity papers appeared here
notes: submit through the partner submission system; a Cambridge Core account is separate from the submission account

field: infant and early childhood development, caregiving
public_contact_or_submission: public site with professional development, LEARN conference and contact routes
why_relevant: practitioner and caregiver-facing body whose stated focus includes infant mental health, regulation and repair; a route to people who meet the residual at the ground
notes: use public programme and conference channels; do not send unsolicited personal email

why_relevant: opt-in preprint route for developmental psychology; lets a refuter see the claim before any journal gate and records a date-stamped version
notes: site resolves to OSF; a preprint is not peer review and must be labelled as a simulated derivation if submitted

public_contact_or_submission: public Contact Us page and Journal for Research on Adolescence listing
why_relevant: covers the later developmental slots, including parenting, education and policy; useful where the question's three outcomes are tracked past infancy
notes: contact page is public; no personal emails listed on the page used
